id: cuad:Zounds Hearing, Inc. - MANUFACTURING DESIGN MARKETING AGREEMENT

findings.quoted_text: Royalties shall be paid 50% at time of shipping and the remaining balance of 50% due in 15-days after the Manufacturer's Products have shipped from the manufacturing facility.

Each Party agrees that in the event it violates the provisions of this Section 15.9, it will pay to the other Party as liquidated damages, and not as a penalty, an amount equal to one hundred times (100 X) of any such employee's then-current base annual salary.
Royalties shall be paid 50% at time of shipping and the remaining balance of 50% due in 15-days after the Manufacturer's Products have shipped from the manufacturing facility.
findings.explanation: Waiting 15 days after shipment to receive the remaining half of your royalty payment creates cash flow delay and collection risk after you have already delivered the goods.
findings.suggested_change: Propose that all royalties and product costs be paid in full prior to shipment.

findings.quoted_text: Each Party agrees that in the event it violates the provisions of this Section 15.9, it will pay to the other Party as liquidated damages, and not as a penalty, an amount equal to one hundred times (100 X) of any such employee's then-current base annual salary.
findings.explanation: A penalty of 100x an employee's base salary for non-solicitation violations is excessively punitive and creates a severe, disproportionate liability risk if a staffing mistake occurs.
findings.suggested_change: Remove the 100x multiplier and replace it with a reasonable liquidated damages cap or limit recovery to actual proved damages.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on royalty payments, waiting 15 days after shipment creates cash flow delays, so I propose that all royalties and product costs be paid in full prior to shipment. - Regarding the relevant clause on liquidated damages, a penalty of 100 times an employee's base salary is excessively punitive, so I propose removing the multiplier and replacing it with a reasonable cap or limiting recovery to actual proved damages. Thank you for your time. Best regards.
